nfl.oneThing: Mike Ditka, the Hall of Fame tight end and former Bears coach, has died at 86, and the league is paying tribute to one of its most recognised figures.

headlines.title: Mike Ditka dies at 86
headlines.summary: Ditka, a Hall of Fame tight end who became a league legend as coach of the Bears, has died at 86.
headlines.whyItMatters: It won't change the standings, but it's a significant loss for the Bears and for the league's history.

headlines.title: Chargers put Rashawn Slater on injured reserve
headlines.summary: The Chargers have placed left tackle Rashawn Slater on injured reserve after ankle surgery for a high ankle sprain. Los Angeles will be without three starting offensive linemen against the Broncos on Sunday.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Chargers are 0–4 and on a four-game losing streak, and losing three starting linemen makes their offensive line a bigger problem.

headlines.title: Eagles release Andy Dalton
headlines.summary: Dalton has been released after losing the Eagles' backup quarterback spot following a costly interception against the Bears.
headlines.whyItMatters: The move clears the way for a new backup, and the Eagles are 2–2 and seventh in the NFC on the playoff list.

headlines.title: Leonard Williams will play for Seahawks against 49ers
headlines.summary: The Seahawks' defence will be at full strength on Sunday, with Williams cleared to play against San Francisco.
headlines.whyItMatters: The 49ers are 4–0 and the Seahawks are 3–1, so a healthy defence matters for Seattle's bid to stay in the NFC West race.

headlines.title: Davis Webb says 'not ideal' to lose play-calling duties
headlines.summary: Broncos offensive coordinator Davis Webb has said losing play-calling duties is not ideal, but he plans to be the best offensive coordinator he can be.
headlines.whyItMatters: Denver is 2–2 and sits just outside the AFC playoff seeds, so changes on offence are being watched closely.

contextCard.title: How injured reserve works
contextCard.body: Players placed on injured reserve are out for a minimum set number of games and can't play until they're activated. Teams use IR to free up a roster spot, and a player who is designated to return can come back after serving that minimum period.

nba.oneThing: The Knicks have paused contract extension talks with four players who are eligible, including starters Karl-Anthony Towns and Josh Hart, coming off their title.

headlines.title: Knicks pause extension talks
headlines.summary: Four Knicks players are eligible for contract extensions, including Towns and Hart, and talks have been paused.
headlines.whyItMatters: Those decisions will shape the Knicks' roster beyond this season, and the pause raises questions about Hart's future in New York.

headlines.title: Joel Embiid denies tardiness report
headlines.summary: Embiid has denied a report that he was late to practice and questioned why it happened, saying 'It feels like I'm an easy target'. ESPN's Mike Breen had earlier apologised for recounting a story that has since been refuted.
headlines.whyItMatters: It's a sideshow rather than a season-shaping story, but it keeps attention on the 76ers before the season starts.
